seo_welcome_description: Capture GPS points, areas and routes on Android and web. Geonest works offline and exports clean field mapping data for GIS tools and spreadsheets.
seo_tutorials_description: Learn how to use Geonest for field mapping, from creating projects to capturing points, areas, routes, editing geometry and exporting data.
seo_privacy_description: Read the Geonest privacy policy for details about data collection, account information, project data and privacy rights.

gps_permission_help_title: Location access is blocked on this device.
gps_permission_help_ios_step_1: Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > ON.
gps_permission_help_ios_step_2: In that same list: Safari Websites > set to While Using the App (or equivalent allow option) and enable precise location if shown.
gps_permission_help_ios_step_3: In Safari on the Geonest page: tap aA > Website Settings > Location > Allow (or Ask, then accept prompt).
gps_permission_help_ios_step_4: Return here and tap Enable location again.
gps_permission_help_android_step_1: In browser site settings, allow Location for this site.
gps_permission_help_android_step_2: In Android app permissions, allow Location for your browser.
gps_permission_help_android_step_3: Return here and tap Enable location again.
gps_permission_help_web_step_1: Check this site's Location permission in your browser.
gps_permission_help_web_step_2: Make sure device-level Location Services are enabled.
gps_permission_help_web_step_3: Return here and tap Enable location again and refresh the page.

home_no_account_sub: Sign in / sign up to sync data across devices and web
landing_sub: Capture points, areas and routes the moment you open the app. No GIS knowledge, complicated configuration or training required.
landing_hero_trust: No account required · Works offline · Start in seconds
landing_footer_tagline: Field mapping for survey teams. Works on Android and web.
landing_footer_rights: Open source under the MIT License.
landing_feature_capture_desc: Record GPS points, areas and routes directly on the map
landing_feature_collab_desc: Invite surveyors via link. Each member uses their own named profile
landing_feature_export_desc: Download your data as GeoJSON, Shapefile, or CSV for use in any GIS tool or spreadsheet
landing_usecase_agriculture_desc: Field boundary mapping, paddock surveys, crop monitoring
landing_cta_platform_note: Works on Android and web. No account required.

early_access_step_accept: 2. Accept the test on Google Play
early_access_steps_note: Step 2 only works once step 1 is done. If Play says the app is unavailable, give step 2 a minute to take effect.
admin_qr_aria: QR code for project join link
tutorials_intro: Replay full onboarding or start only one module.
tutorials_create_sub: From home screen through new project creation.
tutorials_route_sub: Start, record, finish, and save options.
tutorials_edit_sub: Saved list, edit mode, vertex operations.
tutorials_need_project_error: Create at least one project first, then start this tutorial module.
tutorials_no_video: No video available for this module.
tour_home_create_first_project_desc: Tap this button to create a project. The tutorial will continue on the next screen.
tour_new_project_name_desc: Enter a short project name here.
tour_new_project_create_desc: Tap Create. The tour will continue on the project screen.
tour_project_capture_modes_desc: This control switches between GPS and Click workflows. Tap Next to practice Click mode first.
tour_project_switch_click_title: Practical task: switch to Click mode
tour_project_switch_click_desc: Tap the Click mode button now.
tour_project_profile_required_desc: Before recording geometries, make sure an active profile exists. If needed, the tour will guide you through setup.
tour_project_click_point_desc: In Click mode, tap Point to start point capture.
tour_project_place_point_title: Practical task: place a point on the map
tour_project_place_point_desc: Now tap anywhere on the map to create a point geometry.
tour_project_point_name_desc: Add a clear name, for example: "North Gate Marker" or "Tree Plot A1".
tour_project_point_desc_desc: Use Notes for context like condition, purpose, or access hints. Example: "Start of transect, near concrete post."
tour_project_point_coords_desc: If you already have precise coordinates, you can override Latitude and Longitude here before saving.
tour_project_save_point_desc: Save the point in this dialog. Then we move on to Area.
tour_project_click_area_desc: Now tap Area. This is used to add corners and build a polygon boundary on the map.
tour_project_area_corners_desc: Tap multiple points on the map to place corners (at least three) until the boundary is ready.
tour_project_area_finish_desc: When the boundary is valid, tap Finish to open the save dialog for the area.
tour_project_area_name_desc: Give the area a clear name, for example: "North Block Boundary".
tour_project_area_desc_desc: Add context like vegetation, condition, or survey purpose in Notes.
tour_project_save_area_desc: Tap Save to store the area geometry.
tour_project_switch_gps_desc: Tap GPS mode to switch to live-location capture.
tour_project_gps_vs_click_title: GPS vs Click: when to use each
tour_project_gps_vs_click_desc: Use GPS when you are physically on site for live location capture. Use Click when tracing from imagery or known coordinates.
tour_project_features_desc: Tap the features panel to view, rename, or delete your saved points, areas, and routes.
tour_project_gps_route_desc: Route records a continuous path. Tap Route now and the next screen will guide you through Start, Record, Finish, and Save.
tour_project_gps_point_area_desc: Point saves your current GPS fix. Area collects GPS corners around a boundary, then Finish to save.
tour_profile_open_profiles_desc: Tap this to create or select your active profile.
tour_profile_open_menu_desc: Tap your profile button to open profile actions.
tour_profiles_add_desc: Before capturing geometry, add a surveyor profile.
tour_profiles_create_name_desc: Enter a short name for this surveyor profile, then save.
tour_profiles_save_desc: Tap Save to confirm the profile and return to your project.
tour_track_start_desc: Press Start when GPS is ready. If prompted, set/select a profile first.
tour_track_record_path_desc: Move along the route to collect points. Use Pause/Resume as needed. When done, tap Finish.
tour_track_finish_desc: Finish becomes available only after at least 2 points are recorded.
tour_track_cancel_desc: Tap Cancel at any time to stop recording and return to the project without saving.
tour_track_save_result_desc: Choose Save as Track to keep a line path, or Save as Area if the route closes into a boundary.
tour_edit_satellite_pill_desc: This satellite pill shows GPS status and accuracy. Tap it to expand/collapse details.
tour_edit_open_saved_desc: Tap this to switch from map view to your saved geometries list.
tour_edit_geometry_actions_desc: On a saved feature, open More actions to edit geometry or details.
tour_edit_enter_mode_desc: Tap Edit geometry to edit an existing area directly on the map.
tour_edit_alt_entry_desc: You can also enter edit mode by right-clicking on a geometry on desktop, or long-pressing on mobile — no need to open the menu.
tour_edit_reposition_vertex_desc: Drag any blue corner point to move it to a new position.
tour_edit_split_edge_desc: Drag the green midpoint dot on any edge to add a new corner point and reshape the boundary.
tour_edit_delete_vertex_desc: Tap a blue corner point on the map to select it, then press Delete or Backspace to remove it. You can also use the Delete button in the toolbar.
tour_edit_finish_desc: Tap Done to exit edit mode and keep your geometry changes.
tour_edit_next_export_admin_desc: Tap Back to return home. We will export from the project menu and finish in Manage Account.
tour_wrap_project_actions_desc: Open the project menu to access Export and related actions.
tour_wrap_export_desc: Use Export to download CSV, GeoJSON, or Shapefile for sharing and analysis.
tour_wrap_manage_account_desc: Tap Account to open the account area and finish onboarding.
tour_export_formats_desc: GeoJSON, CSV, and Shapefile are available for download — exporting is optional. Close this tip, then tap the top-left back button to return home and continue the tour.
tour_project_back_home_again_desc: Great. One more step: tap Back again to return to Home, where we will continue with Manage Account.
tour_admin_complete_desc: You can change the app language here under Language settings. Need a refresher? Head to Tutorials any time to replay any module.
tour_home_final_desc: Feel free to explore — tap a project to try things out. When you're ready, delete the demo project and start recording your own data. Good luck out there!

seo_feedback_description: Report a bug or suggest an improvement for Geonest.
feedback_privacy_note: We attach your account ID (when signed in), current page URL, locale, device type, app version, and browser info to help us reproduce issues. We do not automatically attach GPS coordinates; screenshots may include information visible on your screen.
